title: Modeled transfer and cache costs
method: Synthetic planning rates: 40,000 GB × $0.05 = $2,000; 16,000 GB × $0.05 = $800 after 60% byte avoidance. Add $300 cache cost for a $900 net modeled reduction. Excludes taxes, tiered rates and other transfer paths.
alt: Modeled transfer and cache costs. Original route: 2000 USD/month; Cached route: 800 USD/month; Added cache cost: 300 USD/month. Illustrative values.
